browser.title: Open Chrome on your computer

install.title: Install the extension
install.store: Open the <store>Chrome Web Store</store> and add Minaly CRM.
install.pilot: Download the ZIP, unzip it, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, then choose Load unpacked.

connect.title: Connect your Minaly account
connect.description: Open the extension on an Instagram or LinkedIn profile and sign in with the Minaly account that has CRM access.

verify.title: Verify one profile
verify.description: Return to a visible profile. Use Add to CRM or update the existing lead, then open CRM to confirm.

onboarding.permissionsDescription: The extension reads the visible profile page on Instagram and LinkedIn so it can prepare a CRM record.
onboarding.limitsDescription: It does not read hidden pages, send social messages or change your account permissions.

troubleshootingLabels.pilot: You are using the pilot package

troubleshooting.notVisible: Refresh the social profile and make sure Minaly CRM is enabled for that site.
troubleshooting.notConnected: Open the Minaly panel, sign in, then choose “I’m done, check again.”
troubleshooting.crmUnavailable: Ask the account owner to enable CRM and give you CRM access.
troubleshooting.pilot: Keep the pilot folder unzipped. When Chrome asks for a folder, choose that folder.

messageTests.title: First message tests
messageTests.subtitle: Compare two opening messages on one channel and track replies for seven days after each copy.

list.emptyBody: Create a first message test to compare two messages on Instagram or LinkedIn.

form.name: Test name

form.observationValue: 7 days after the message is copied
form.audioNote: Audio versions are not available yet.

form.createdBody: New leads on this channel will now receive variant A or B.

detail.collectingBody: Some copied messages are still within their seven day observation window.

warning.body: At least one version has fewer than 50 completed observation windows. Keep collecting data before comparing reply rates.

actions.endBody: No new lead will receive a variant. Replies to messages already copied will be tracked until their seven day windows end. This action is final.
